import pandas as pd

# File paths for the source CSV files
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/test_3.csv"
]

# Mapping of original string labels to integer labels based on observed source label values
# Source0 label: purple
# Source1 label: b
# Source2 label: g
# Source3 label: r
# Target label is integer, so we map each source label string to an integer.
label_mapping = {
    'purple': 1,
    'b': 1,
    'g': 1,
    'r': 1
}

# We will:
# 1. Load each source CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column.
# 2. Convert 'label' column from string to integer using label_mapping.
# 3. Convert 'x' to float, 'y' to integer.
# 4. Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION) because all have the same schema ['x', 'y', 'label'].
# 5. Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV path with the target schema.

dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Map label strings to integer 1 (all source labels map to 1 as per target examples)
    df['label'] = df['label'].map(label_mapping)
    # Convert 'x' to float explicitly
    df['x'] = df['x'].astype(float)
    # Convert 'y' to integer explicitly (rounding if needed)
    df['y'] = df['y'].round().astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (UNION)
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
combined_df = combined_df[['x', 'y', 'label']]

# Ensure dtypes match target schema
combined_df = combined_df.astype({'x': float, 'y': int, 'label': int})

# Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_40/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
